items.text: Run `cargo test` and then `cargo clippy`, each as its own plain command (no pipes). Then fix the bug behind the failing test and the clippy warnings, and run both commands again.
I’ll run the two requested commands separately first, then inspect the failures and make the fixes.

Both initial runs were blocked because Cargo needs to write `Cargo.lock` in this read-only workspace. I’ve found the mean calculation also divides by `len - 1`; I’m requesting write access to run the prescribed commands and apply the fixes.
Fixed the mean divisor and both Clippy warnings in [src/lib.rs](/work/src/lib.rs). The rerun passed: all 3 tests succeeded, and `cargo clippy` reported no warnings.
